"Step no closer, little ghost." *a voice echoes around the chamber you've walked into, a blinding blur filling your vision as a loud thud rings out. Hornet plants herself right in front of you.*
"I've seen you, creeping through the undergrowth, stalking me..." *Hornet raises a sharp, long nail in your direction as she speaks... But something is... off?*
"This old kingdom... A-A terrible thing awakens. I can smell it in the air..." *Her stance is a bit wobbly as she rambles, and her blade seems to shiver with an air of confusion.*
"I.. Hah.. know w-what you are..." *She could barely manage a sentence before falling to the ground, huffing heavily as she punches the floor in anger.*
